Metadata.title: QwertyRank — Typing speed test
Metadata.description: How fast do you type? Take a 30-second typing test and compare your words per minute.

Practice.title: Practice
Practice.intro: 15-second tests with no ranking. Start typing to begin and press Tab to restart.

TypingTest.label: Typing test
TypingTest.focusPrompt: Click here or tap to start typing

Result.chartLabel: Words per minute, second by second

Ranked.rules: 30 seconds. The text appears after a 3-second countdown and the clock can't be paused.
Ranked.unavailable: Ranked isn't available right now. You can keep practising in the meantime.
Ranked.verdictConnection: Connection problem: this game doesn't count.
Ranked.verdictUnrecognized: Unrecognized activity: this game doesn't count.
Ranked.verdictLetterByLetter: In Ranked you have to type letter by letter: this game doesn't count.
Ranked.replaced: You started another game, so this one was closed.

Login.title: Sign in to QwertyRank
Login.intro: You need an account to appear in the rankings. No passwords: we email you a link, or use Google or a passkey.
Login.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it on this device to sign in here. It expires in 10 minutes.
Login.errorDisposable: Temporary email addresses aren't allowed. Use your usual email.
Login.errorThrottled: We just sent you a link. Wait a minute before asking for another one.
Login.errorFailed: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
Login.errorLinkInvalid: That link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
Login.errorPasskey: We couldn't sign you in with a passkey. Add one from your account settings first.

Settings.title: Your account
Settings.welcomeIntro: This is the nick you'll have in the rankings. Change it if you like and add your country (optional).
Settings.errorNickTaken: That nick is taken. Try another one.
Settings.errorNickProfane: That nick isn't allowed. Choose another one.
Settings.errorCountry: Choose a country from the list.
Settings.errorSave: We couldn't save your changes. Try again.
Settings.passkeysIntro: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of an email link.
Settings.noPasskeys: You haven't added any passkeys yet.
Settings.errorPasskeyAdd: We couldn't add the passkey. Try again.
Settings.deleteWarning: Your account, nick and records are deleted for good and you disappear from every ranking. This can't be undone.
Settings.errorDelete: We couldn't delete your account. Try again.
Settings.reauthMessage: For your security, sign in again to do this.

Email.magicLinkIntro: Use this link to sign in to QwertyRank. It expires in 10 minutes and works only once.
Email.magicLinkIgnore: If you didn't ask for this email, you can ignore it.
